materials.content: Pastel on paper, mounted on illustration board

Pastel on moderately thick, white, slightly textured laid paper mounted to gray cardboard, illustration board* 
Watermark: Blind stamp at corner, STRATHMORE with thistle

cr_data.provenance: [Downtown Gallery, New York, until 1960; stock no. 248; sold on November 1, 1960 to private collection]; private collection, Wilmington, Del. (1960–at least 1961); [Robert Miller Gallery, New York, until 1980; sold in 1980 to private collection]; private collection (1980–81; their gift to MMA) (Source: The Met, 2025)

remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at American Place, March 1946. . . . On backing: In pencil by O'Keeffe 'A Storm'/22" [not verified]. Whitney Archive indicates, "No signature. See gallery photograph 2–d." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: OK initials and star" [not verified]. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert . . . Nov, 1960." Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 13. Mentioned in 1934 New York (An American Place) exhibition review in *New York Times* (1934). See cat. nos. 381–84, 386, 387. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: A Storm

description: Lightning emerging from a dark cloud shoots down the center of the composition. The lightning illuminates a dark sky and strip of land or sea below. Two semicircles of white light emanate from the two bottom corners of the image.
